art_direction: confident contemporary campaign poster with one recognizable product or service subject and disciplined graphic energy
palette: warm white, ink black, vermilion red, cobalt blue and one restrained lime accent
typography: bold modern Chinese sans serif for the conclusion with compact neutral sans support and deliberate line breaks
materials: flat printed color fields, crisp crop edges, subtle coated-paper grain and controlled studio light

anchors.prompt: one clean product or service silhouette
one decisive cobalt or vermilion color block

text_layout: use a clear medium or large conclusion with compact supporting copy; a page may be a poster statement, a product caption or an integrated claim rather than a giant headline
contrast: ink-black or bone-white text on a flat, quiet color field; keep product edges and bright highlights away from letters

poster-claim.label: 传播主张
poster-claim.summary: 用平面色块和清晰主张制造第一眼记忆
poster-claim.composition: one confident conclusion in a flat color field with a single graphic mark and a restrained secondary subject
poster-claim.imagery: poster geometry, cropped object silhouette or abstract service gesture; no extra campaign copy
requirements: color contrast remains readable in projection

product-studio.label: 产品影棚
product-studio.summary: 用干净的主体、光线和留白呈现产品或服务
product-studio.composition: clean studio hero with one centered product or service metaphor and a protected text field
product-studio.imagery: abstract product silhouette, service touchpoint or supplied product asset; never invent a real brand identity

title_treatment.weight: quiet product caption or concise claim

requirements: copy never crosses the subject or specular highlight
avoid: product render that implies unsupported features

campaign-comparison.label: 传播对照
campaign-comparison.summary: 用两块平面区域清楚比较两个选择或阶段
campaign-comparison.composition: two graphic fields with equal visual weight, a decisive divider and one concise comparison conclusion
campaign-comparison.imagery: paired silhouettes, flat color blocks or aligned service scenes; dimensions remain supplied by exact_text
requirements: both sides use the same comparison dimension
do not let decoration become a third option

campaign-flow.label: 行动路径
campaign-flow.summary: 把服务或产品动作压缩成一条可记忆的路径
campaign-flow.composition: one bold path across a poster field with separated stages and a clear forward direction
campaign-flow.imagery: graphic arrows, blocks and simple objects; labels only from exact_text
requirements: stage order must be immediately readable

campaign-data.label: 传播数据
campaign-data.summary: 用少量有来源的数字支持传播判断
campaign-data.composition: one crisp metric or comparison shape on a high-contrast campaign field with generous margins
campaign-data.imagery: flat bars, rings or dots; all values and units come from exact_text or evidence
requirements: show the supplied unit and comparison dimension
avoid implying precision beyond the evidence

campaign-signal.label: 传播信号
campaign-signal.summary: 让一条引文或判断成为传播锚点
campaign-signal.composition: one supplied quote or signal sentence with one graphic mark and an intentionally quiet opposite field
campaign-signal.imagery: abstract campaign mark or color block; no invented author, source or slogan
requirements: the supplied quote remains the only verbal focus
